notes: Folder-URL installs: the install prompt can now name the pack's folder (e.g. https://www.ibuildwith.ai/share/musepacks/beer-tracker-pack/) and the installer resolves the musepack.yaml inside it — users no longer need the full manifest URL. Also includes always-present declaration files (0.7.0), the capabilities/connectors split (0.6.0), mechanical used_by id validation (0.5.1), side chat creation (0.4.0), mandatory integrity verification (0.3.1), the opt-in daily update check (0.3.0), and the Quality & Safety gate (0.2.0).
